ui_bugs.issue: Tapping book-swap-button does NOT swap From/To; it opens the 'Flying to' AirportPicker. The 40x40 swap Pressable is nested inside styles.divider (height:1), so overflow falls into the book-to-button Pressable below and captures the tap. Reproduced with both testID click and bounding-box center-click. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx around the <View style={styles.divider}><Pressable style={styles.swap} testID="book-swap-button"/></View> block and styles.divider at height:1.

issues: styles.divider height:1 with a 40x40 child button is a layout smell - prefer a container row with explicit height (e.g. 40 or 44) that properly bounds the swap Pressable, or absolutely position the swap over a visible border. Current pattern causes overlapping hit regions and makes book-swap-button unreachable via centered tap.

action_items: Fix book-swap-button hit region in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx. Suggested: wrap From row + swap + To row in a parent View of height 72+72+(gap) and absolutely position the swap button over the divider (e.g. style={{position:'absolute', right:16, top: rowHeight-20, zIndex:2, elevation:2}}), OR increase styles.divider to height:40 with alignItems:'flex-end' and ensure the row Pressables don't pointer-event the overflowing child (use pointerEvents='box-none' on a bounding wrapper). After fix, verify: (a) testID click on book-swap-button triggers swap, (b) no airport picker opens on swap tap, (c) From/To values are exchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx line ~293 styles.divider uses height:1 as a layout container for a 40x40 swap button. Child overflow outside a Pressable parent is unreliable on web (and on RN Android) - taps on the overflowing portion hit the sibling Pressables (book-from-button above and book-to-button below). The XO-style UX works only because the swap visually overlaps the thin border; functionally the hit region is broken on web.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx search() always falls back to depart=isoDate(DAYS[6]) when user hasn't picked a date; good. However book-date-value shows 'Date' placeholder until a date is picked, so a user who taps Search without opening the date sheet gets a quote dated 6 days out silently. Consider showing the implicit default in book-date-value (e.g. 'Date · today+6') for transparency.

All 8 configured routes currently have a nonstop option so it's fine today, but add a defensive check or fallback jet for future route additions.

rca_of_issue: book-swap-button overlay bug: The swap Pressable (styles.swap: 40x40) is nested inside styles.divider (height:1), which sits between two full-width Pressables (book-from-button, book-to-button). On RN-Web the layout engine lets the 40x40 child overflow its 1px-tall parent visually, but hit-testing on web uses CSS stacking/DOM order: the sibling Pressables (book-to-button, rendered after the divider) lie underneath the swap button's overflowing bottom half in DOM order, and because the divider is only 1px tall its event region is tiny. Playwright's testID-targeted click resolves to the swap element but the click lands at the element's visual center, which on web dispatches a click event that bubbles - and because the swap button doesn't call stopPropagation / preventDefault and the row Pressable below also has a pointer handler covering the same visual region, the row's onPress fires. Repro: see the browser_automation output showing 'After testID-click: from=Dubai (DXB), to=Doha (DOH), picker-open=True, SWAP WORKED: False'. Mitigation: either absolutely position swap on top with zIndex and set the row's pointerEvents behavior, or expand the divider's height to properly contain the swap Pressable and let the row Pressables be adjacent rather than overlapping.
